ui.vite-config: Disabled because the rule's premise does not hold here: this package has no build.
What the rule is right about: CP JavaScript has to be compiled with `@statamic/cms/vite-plugin`,
otherwise the bundle carries a second Vue and nothing mounts.
Why that is not this repository's job: `resources/js` is installed by the host addons as
`statamic-funnels/vite.config.js`, both with the Statamic plugin, `preserveSymlinks` and a
`dedupe` on vue and @vue-flow/*. That is where the one-Vue guarantee is made, and it is the
only place it can be made: a bundle built here would be exactly the second copy the rule warns about.
A vite.config.js in this repo would therefore describe a build that does not exist. The test
runner reads `vitest.config.js` instead, so the linter does not mistake it for one.
